messages:
Marta: Quick proposal to refactor the Dedicated autoscaler — separate 'scale intent' generation from the allocation/execution layer. Draft RFC: https://internal.redwood/rfcs/autoscale-intent

Shane: tl;dr on benefits vs current monolithic scaler?

Marta: High level wins:
- clean control-plane <> runtime API boundary
- easier A/B of scaling strategies (swap intent generators)
- safer rollback (revoke intent instead of killing nodes mid-serve)
- allocator can prewarm more cheaply when given explicit intent

Devin: ok. where does runtime admission live? we currently gate per-request at runtime.

Marta: admission stays in runtime, but it consults the intent API as the authoritative upcoming capacity hint. Proposed flow:
1) intent-generator watches signals (queue depth, SLOs, GPU util, burst credits)
2) it posts a scale intent: pool, delta, prewarm flag, expiry, reason
3) allocator consumes intents, issues infra ops and returns prewarm tokens
4) runtime admission checks tokens + instance health to open burst lanes

Leah: can we keep the intent payload tiny for SDKs? example?

Marta: example payload (kept minimal):
```json
POST /v1/pools/intent
{
  "pool_id": "ded-rtx-a",
  "change": 4,
  "prewarm": true,
  "expiry_ts": 1840127000,
  "reason": "latency_slo:95>200ms",
  "strategy": "burst-credit"
}
```

Shane: expiry_ts is helpful to auto-expire old intents. what about partial fulfillment? intent asks for 4 GPUs but only 2 come up.

Marta: allocator exposes a lightweight status API: intent_id -> desired, fulfilled, prewarm_ready, created_ts. Runtime admission looks at fulfilled + prewarm_ready.

Samir: billing concern: dedicated customers expect reserved units; intents could be misinterpreted as billed reserves.

Marta: agree. include billing_mode on intents: reserved | ephemeral | burst_credit. The policy/guardrail layer will map intents to billing actions.

Devin: another risk: noisy-neighbor will create alert storms & a flurry of intents. Need rate limits and cooldown.

Leah: propose token-bucket per-tenant + a global circuit breaker. Also add a confidence float on intents so allocator deprioritizes low-confidence ones.

Shane: we need a quick revoke path in case intent-generator goes haywire. ops should revoke intent without tearing nodes down manually.

Marta: revoke API sketch:
```
DELETE /v1/pools/intent/{intent_id}
```
Allocator reconciles active instances vs active intents periodically.

deploybot: deploybot: created branch autoscale/intent-api-refactor, CI queued :rocket:

Samir: testing plan? how do we validate behavior before flipping production traffic?

Marta: staged rollout plan:
- deploy intent API behind a flag
- run intent-generator in read-only (emit intents but don't apply)
- run allocator in dry-run reconcile mode, emit diffs to logs
- enable tiny fraction of runtime traffic to consult intent status for admission
- monitor SLOs and expand if stable

Devin: region boundaries: intents must be regional and include affinity tags. Cross-region prewarm costs are too high otherwise.

Leah: piggyback model/runtime metadata so allocator picks compatible instance images/quant kernels, e.g. tags: model=llama-3,quant=q8.

Marta: intent schema will include freeform tags array for that. Also add region field.

Shane: fallback behavior: if intent service is unavailable, runtime falls back to current heuristics (util + queue). Intent is advisory/adopted incrementally.

Samir: logs/traces: include intent_id in request traces so we can link admission decisions back to the originating intent.

Marta: will add trace headers: X-Intent-Id and X-Intent-Confidence in the draft.

Leah: also want an experiment to measure cold-start delta with prewarm true/false to quantify savings.

Shane: action items:
- Marta: push RFC + JSON schema by EOD
- Devin: draft allocator reconciliation pseudocode
- Leah: token-bucket + circuit breaker spec
- Samir: billing mapping and audit checks
- Shane: add region & model tag requirements to routing metadata

Marta: will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

infra-bot: ci: branch autoscale/intent-api-refactor passed unit tests :white_check_mark:

Leah: +1. Let's track metrics: intents/sec, intents.fulfilled_ratio, prewarm_success_rate, intent_revokes.

Marta: good call. I'll add dashboard templates in the followup doc and sample SDK snippets for emitting intents.

Shane: if no objections by EOD I'll cut the implementation PR and pair with infra for rollout.

Devin: no objections here. excited to see the revoke workflow in action.

Marta: closing loop, will post RFC link when done.
